svg.aria-label: cute-rs preview against CuTeDSL 4.7: a status grid of feature areas for CuTeDSL 4.7 and the cute-rs preview on sm_100a and sm_120a
svg.text: Rust CuTe kernels compiled ahead of time through the pinned CUTLASS 4.7 compiler for two Blackwell targets. Status at 5eaa6cbda (2026-10-22).
layouts are Rust types checked at compile time; no layout ops in kernels
runtime lengths and one runtime row pitch; strides and tiles are types
1D tiles (zipped_divide, slice, 1D local_tile) and fixed 2D block-scaled views; no make_tiled_copy
2D tile load and store, two-CTA load; no im2col, reduce-store, multicast
cooperative cp.async with a coverage proof; no bulk or DSMEM data copies
ldmatrix x4 and x2.trans, stmatrix x2, no-allocate stores; no atomics
1 of 11 kinds: F16 in, F32 accumulate, one or two CTAs
3 of 7 kinds: MXF4 with UE8M0 scales (sm_120a), F16, BF16
NVFP4 projections run on CUDA cores through scaled loads and dot
allocate, 32x32b load and store, FP32 to FP16; no 16xNb, LdRed or S2T
5 typed pipelines and a two-CTA ring; no CLC, no compiler pipelining
one static 1D persistent scheduler; no grouped, CLC or stream-K
two-CTA clusters validated; no N-CTA multicast plan
two fixed FP16 epilogues, bias on sm_100a; activations fused by hand
f16, f32 native; BF16 and FP4 carriers; no inline PTX or libdevice
full Rust control flow and traps, MLIR dumps; no device printf
Host: JIT, torch, JAX, AOT export
AOT cubin inside the Rust binary; no JIT, no Python interop
no autotuner, schedule checker or in-kernel tracing
whole-module layout, pipeline and role checks; CuTeDSL checks at trace
4 sm_100a and 10 sm_120a example crates versus 86 CuTeDSL kernel files
Qwen3-TTS 1.7B and Qwen3-8B on sm_120a; CuTeDSL ships none
Every other architecture is rejected before compilation. The support matrix page in the cuda-oxide book has the full table and evidence.
